---
title: "Treatment effects"
---

```{python}
from _lib import *
tr = read("treatments")
```

Many datasets come from experiments, with factors such as nitrogen, water, temperature,
pathogens, herbivory and genotype. For each dataset, factor and trait, the effect of each
level against the control is a log response ratio, $\ln(\bar y_{trt}/\bar y_{ctl})$, with
bootstrap 90 % intervals. Effects are computed from RTM best estimates and from in-situ
measurements; where both exist, they are shown side by side.

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Log response ratio vs control (90 % bootstrap interval). Circles: RTM estimates; squares: measurements."
if len(tr):
    t = tr[tr["trait"].isin(TRAIT)].copy()
    t["label"] = t["dataset_id"] + " · " + t["factor"] + "=" + t["level"].astype(str) + " · " + t["trait"].map(lambda x: trait_label(x, False))
    t = t.sort_values(["dataset_id", "factor", "trait", "level"])
    fig = go.Figure()
    for src, sym, col in [("rtm", "circle", "#2a78d6"), ("measured", "square", "#eb6834")]:
        g = t[t["source"] == src]
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=g["lrr"], y=g["label"], mode="markers", name=src,
                                 marker=dict(symbol=sym, size=9, color=col, line=dict(color=SURFACE, width=2)),
                                 error_x=dict(type="data", symmetric=False, array=g["lrr_q95"] - g["lrr"],
                                              arrayminus=g["lrr"] - g["lrr_q05"], color=col, thickness=1.5, width=0),
                                 customdata=np.c_[g["n_treat"], g["n_control"]],
                                 hovertemplate="%{y}<br>LRR %{x:.3f}<br>n = %{customdata[0]} vs %{customdata[1]}<extra>" + src + "</extra>"))
    fig.add_vline(x=0, line=dict(color=AXIS, width=1))
    fig.update_layout(height=max(400, 22 * t["label"].nunique()), margin=dict(l=420),
                      xaxis_title="log response ratio", legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.04))
    show(fig)
else:
    no_data()
```
